summary: GWAS identified genes influencing maize kernel oil content and fatty acid composition; validated genes included DGAT1-2, FATB and FAD2.
A chromosome 6 QTL near linoleic acid1 explained a large fraction of 18:1/18:2 ratio variation in maize kernel oil.
Maize oil QTL review/analysis notes qHO6 encoding DGAT1-2, QTL-Pal9 with FATB/acyl-ACP thioesterase, and KCS/FAD/SACD/LACS genes in oil-related QTL intervals.
Maize oil mainly accumulates in embryo and is dominated by palmitic, stearic, oleic, linoleic and linolenic acids.
